notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1p.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a Command Console. Press  `  during a flight to toggle it… cheater.
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f0a186ad8b4a66a2927d90b/d235050c-b5b2-4ee9-b829-231e6eaae070/command+console.jpg?format=2500w[/img]

[*] Changed Shield Energy drop rate from 3% to 5%
[*] Got rid of broken enemies that would spawn in and prevent you from advancing to the next sub-sector
[*] Sector backgrounds are now changed properly when you move to the next Sector 
[*] You can now open the inventory on a controller by pressing Y/North Button
[/list]
[url=narzioth.games/red-sector/patch-notes/4-8-2023/patch-notes-01p1][b]You can view the full list of changes here.[/b][/url]
